newsitem.title: CHINA: China province sugar output seen over 1.0 mln T.
newsitem.headline: China province sugar output seen over 1.0 mln T.

text.p: Sugar output in China's southwestern province of Yunnan is seen topping one million tonnes in the 1996/97 (November/April) season, up 170,000 tonnes from the previous season, the Xinhua news agency said on Thursday.
The forecast was for the sugar production season from 1996-97, Xinhua quoted the Yunnan provincial light and textile industries office as saying.
The province's output of pressed sugarcane would reach 9.5 million tonnes this year, a rise of 1.68 million tonnes from last year, it said.
Yunnan's planted area for sugar cane hit 187,000 hectares (462,000 acres) in 1996, a rise of 12,000 hectares (30,000 acres) compared with 1995, it said.
Yunnan is one of China's three main sugar producing regions.
